options.text: The answer is the fixed side lengths $5$ and $12$.
Any $x$ from $7$ to $17$ inclusive works, including the endpoints.
The same rule also decides the perimeter once the triangle is built.

stem:
Pallavi has two sticks of lengths $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ and $12\,\mathrm{cm}$. She wants a third stick of length $x\,\mathrm{cm}$ so the three lengths can form a triangle.

Which claim about $x$ is correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Triangle inequality requires |12-5| < x < 12+5, so 7 < x < 17 with endpoints excluded. Naming the fixed sides, including 7 and 17, or shifting to perimeter all miss that range.
